title: Record to Report accountant
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
  
  
**About The Role**
Job Summary
  
  
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
  
  
The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues
* Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations
* Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records
* Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes
* Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations
* Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements
* Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider
* Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger
* Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)
* Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates
* Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role
* Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA
* Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

**Education And Experience**

* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting
* CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

**Critical success factors**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment
* Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

**Technical & Language Skills**

* Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software
* Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
* Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus
* Proficiency in English

**Interfaces with**

* Accounting teams
* Reporting & Analytics team
* Local Accounting Managers
* Country Finance Heads
* RTR GPO
* External stakeholders (i.e. auditors, tax authorities etc.)

What we offer you
  
  
Medical insurance for self and family
  
  
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days
  
  
Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
  
  
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company:**

One XL Info LLP(India and UAE)

**Position:**

Accountant

**Job Type:**

Full-Time

**Shifts/Working Hours:**

Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM

**Experience:**

2+  Years

**Location:**

Thergaon, Pune, Maharashtra

**CTC:**

₹ 20,000 - ₹ 25,000 per month

**About Us**

1XL is a Dubai-based company focused on empowering individuals and organisations through growth, innovation, and success. We inspire individuals and organisations to reach their full potential through tailored, market-proven solutions.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage accounting operations for our UAE group entities remotely and our India entity. The role involves maintaining books of accounts in Tally Prime, handling bank reconciliations, supporting taxation and payroll compliance, preparing financial reports, and coordinating with the Dubai team, auditors, and other stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. UAE Group Entities**

* Record purchases, sales, receipts, payments, and journal entries in Tally Prime with proper supporting documentation.
* Prepare monthly bank reconciliations and resolve unmatched transactions.
* Maintain tenant rent, post-dated cheque (PDC), and vendor payment trackers.
* Prepare VAT working schedules, including input and output VAT registers, for review by the Dubai team.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and inter-company reconciliations.
* Prepare audit and Corporate Tax schedules as required.

**2. India Entity**

* Maintain books of accounts in Tally Prime and ensure accurate recording of financial transactions.
* Handle TDS calculations, quarterly returns, and issuance of TDS certificates.
* Support GST compliance, monthly payroll processing, PF, and Professional Tax.
* Track foreign inward remittances, Foreign Inward Remittance Certificates (FIRCs), and export-of-service invoicing.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors and assist with ROC/LLP annual filings.
* Prepare monthly bank balance, cash flow, expense, and other financial reports for management.

**3. Reporting and Coordination**

* Maintain accurate accounting records, ledgers, and financial trackers.
* Ensure timely completion of reconciliations, reports, and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with the Dubai finance team and other stakeholders for accounting information and clarifications.
* Maintain proper documentation and support audit requirements.

**Key Skills Required**

* **Qualification:**

  B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent.
* **Experience:**

  Minimum 2+ years of practical accounting experience.
* Hands-on experience with Tally Prime and good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and SUMIFS.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, payroll, PF, and Professional Tax.
* Knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax will be an added advantage; training will be provided where required.
* Good written English communication skills for daily coordination with the Dubai team.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and time management.
* Pune-based candidates or candidates willing to relocate to Pune.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Monthly bank reconciliations completed by the 5th working day.
* Timely statutory filings with minimal errors and no avoidable late fees.
* Accurate accounting records and financial schedules submitted to Dubai within agreed deadlines.
* No unexplained or unreconciled suspense balances at month-end.

**Selection Process**

1. **Technical Interview:**

   Video call to assess accounting knowledge and relevant experience.
2. **Practical Accounting Test:**

   Approximately 60 minutes, covering accounting entries, Tally Prime, Excel, and reconciliations.
3. **Final Discussion and Offer:**

   Discussion regarding role expectations, salary, and joining availability.

title: FPA VMC Analyst
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
  
  
For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**Role –**
The VMC FP&A Analyst reports to the BU FP&A VMC Team Lead and works closely with the BU Head, BU FP&A, R2R, Costing Analyst, IBP, ISC and Commercial Navigators / Controller, creating an impact by providing high value adding analysis on variable manufacturing cost (VMC) of the respective BU at various levels (BU, Performance Cell, Region, Country, Legal Entity, Site, Customer-Material to the ISC and Commercial association.
  
  
**VMC CoE End to End Scope:**
The VMC CoE Analyst collaborates with BU finance leadership to provide a detailed overview of VMC development, using advanced data platforms like CFIN, CRYSTAL, Power BI, Alteryx, and SAP BI. They identify cost variance drivers, conduct root cause analysis, and work with other pillars to implement corrective actions. The Analyst also supports future cost planning for critical pricing decisions.
  
  
As a reliable business partner, the Analyst identifies and flags process and system related issues, ensuring adherence to accounting standards and AkzoNobel’s P&L guidance (PLENT). They contribute to key projects and continuously improve processes through CI initiatives.
  
  
Candidates should be open to learning new skills and flexible in exploring new ways of working. AkzoNobel promotes a dynamic work culture with a focus on technology adoption to stay ahead of the curve. Analysts are expected to prioritize skill development to keep pace with market and competitor advancements, such as AI and Automation.
  
  
**Key Activities**

* Planning (QRF + Budget):
* Budget Preparation: Prepare budget templates, gather inputs, and load FLM data; run validation checks and resolve data issues.
* Rolling Forecast: Update drivers and post approved manual adjustments; ensure documentation and version control.
* Forecast Translation: Upload and reconcile forecast data in HFM; resolve validation errors under guidance.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Collect inputs from Demand, Data Science, Costing, and Procurement FP&A; track submissions to closure.
* Cost Trend Packs: Generate cost-trend reports vs PY/BUD/QRF; prepare variance tables and initial commentary.
* VMC Bridge Build: Consolidate inputs for PVM bridge and co-ordinate with HRT; validate mappings and ensure consistency with prior versions.
* Strategic Business Support:
* Variance Packs: Prepare MEC variance packs and waterfall charts; summarize drivers for review.
* A06 Preparation: Populate A06 templates; compare to prior periods and fix mapping issues.
* KPI Dashboard: Refresh KPI dashboards (VMC, VMC/L); run data-quality checks and highlight outliers.
* PVM Observations: Draft observations from PVM results for VMC Story telling.
* IBP Support: Compile IBP materials, update slides, record minutes and action owners
* Inventory Revaluation: Calculate RMPI-based forecast impact; maintain workings and assumptions repository.
* Data & Process Integrity (System hygiene, process hygiene):
* Data Hygiene Monitoring: Run exception/integrity reports; flag anomalies (e.g., not-in-use materials) to owners.
* RCA Support: Provide data extracts and trend summaries for RCAs; track action status.
* Gap Ticketing: Raise system/process gap tickets and follow up to resolution.
* Process Improvements:
* Product Cost Checks: Validate BOM/routing and cost splits; flag anomalies to costing.
* CI & Automation: Build macros/Power Query/Power BI measures; document steps and handover notes.
* System Reconciliations: Execute reconciliation scripts across HFM/CFIN/Crystal/SAP; log and categorize issues.
* Digital Tool Usage: Adopt approved AI/digital tools; provide structured feedback.
* Data Standards: Apply naming conventions and data definitions consistently.
* Project Support:
* Project Documentation: Maintain project trackers, timelines, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependency) logs for assigned initiatives.
* Data Provisioning: Extract, cleanse, and provision datasets for project charters and ad hoc analyses.

**Education**

* Proven work experience “5 to 7 years” in a strategic financial analysis role is essential.
* Qualified chartered or cost accountant or similar equivalent professional competency.
* Experience in large scale manufacturing industry/GBS/GCC. Leveraging deep industry knowledge to enhance financial analysis, cost management, and strategic planning.
* Focus on stakeholder management (e.g. BU Head of Finance, Head of FP&A, Reg Proc Director, Comm, ISC Navigators, Acc Controller, R2R, etc.) engaging to drive actions that support strategic objectives.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting, optimize data processes, and provide strategic insights to support high-level decision-making (VMC FP&A team is collectively analyzing Variable Manufacturing Cost of around 6 billion €, BU wise ranging from 0.3 billion € to 1 billion €).
* In-depth knowledge of process order settlement and material ledger runs, familiarity with Inter Company (ICD) transactions, proficiency in managing material master attributes, strong analytical skills for financial reviews, and effective communication skills for managing price variations and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Possess in-depth knowledge of Financial & Cost accounting, Product costing, Transfer pricing, IFRS, Financial Statements, and System accounting flow, with a dynamic and innovative approach to problem-solving.
* Must have experience in a multinational company, demonstrating a proven track record of success. Ability to think outside the box and drive strategic financial initiatives.
* Support in managing external financial reporting & ensuring compliance. Responsibilities include preparing VMC Price Volume Mix reporting and Analysis “A06”.
* Proven experience in managing complex organizational setups. Responsibilities include overseeing intricate financial structures, ensuring seamless integration of financial systems, and optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

title: Lead Analyst Procurement
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
:

The Lead Analyst Procurement supports category strategy and sourcing activities across the allocated categories. The role contributes market insight, commercial analysis, and structured supplier support to ensure services are sourced and managed in a way that delivers measurable value, operational efficiency, and long-term performance – not only for the assigned categories. Applying category management best practices, the role supports spend analysis, supply market intelligence, industry benchmarking of pricing and service delivery models, supplier segmentation, and the development of sourcing strategies that balance cost efficiency with service quality and innovation. Working closely with the internal stakeholders, the role translates operational priorities into sourcing approaches and supplier solutions. Operating within a global procurement framework, the role supports consistent application of category strategy, sourcing governance, and supplier management practices, while leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency. ESG and supplier diversity considerations are applied as part of broader sourcing decisions, in line with company policy.

**Major Responsibilities:**

1. Conduct spend data analysis and generate actionable insights, identifying cost drivers, spending patterns, supplier concentration, and opportunities for savings and improved contract coverage
2. Support the development and execution of category strategies incorporating spend analysis, supply market intelligence, and industry benchmarking of pricing, supplier practices, and service delivery models to inform sourcing direction and stakeholder recommendations
3. Analyze market trends, to identify solutions that meet business needs across the categories in scope
4. Contribute to measurable value creation through sourcing initiatives and supplier engagement that deliver cost savings, improved cash flow, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-led innovation
5. Identify opportunities to optimize supplier footprint, service delivery models, and commercial structures
6. Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and ensure procurement activities support operational priorities
7. Support competitive sourcing processes including RFI and RFP, supplier negotiations, and contract award in line with company procurement policies and governance requirements
8. Assist in supplier performance monitoring through clear service expectations, performance reviews, and issue resolution to ensure reliable service delivery
9. Support contract management and supplier governance to ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms, service levels, and risk requirements, including data privacy considerations and appropriate regard for ESG and supplier diversity
10. Contribute to process simplification and supply base rationalization to reduce complexity, improve service consistency, and strengthen commercial leverage
11. Monitor category spend, supplier concentration, and contract coverage, leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to identify opportunities for cost control, efficiency, and risk mitigation

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Value delivered across the categories in scope including cost savings, cash improvement, service quality, and risk mitigation, benchmarked against industry standards
* Quality and actionability of spend data analysis, market intelligence, and industry benchmarking delivered to support category strategy and sourcing decisions
* Delivery of sourcing initiatives and contracts
* Supplier performance against agreed service levels including quality, reliability, responsiveness, and issue resolution
* Compliance with Procurement policy, contracting standards, and applicable regulations including data privacy and basic ESG requirements
* Continuity and reliability of critical services
* Timely execution of sourcing processes including RFI, RFP, negotiations, and contract implementation
* Supply base effectiveness including appropriate supplier coverage, service consistency, and managed risk exposure
* Effective use of digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency
* Growing personal capability, engagement, and effectiveness within the Procurement team

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Working knowledge of data analytics tools such as Excel or Power BI as well as AI tools
* Working knowledge of procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba is a plus
* Foundational knowledge or coursework in project management is a plus

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management, including exposure to service-based categories, within global or multi-regional organizations
* Hands-on experience with spend data analysis and procurement analytics, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for category strategy and stakeholder recommendations
* Demonstrated experience supporting category strategies and sourcing initiatives that delivered measurable cost savings, cash flow improvement, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-driven solutions
* Experience conducting market benchmarking, supply market intelligence, and spend analysis to inform sourcing direction and category strategy
* Commercial acumen and developing negotiation skills, with the ability to support competitive sourcing processes and evaluate commercial proposals, payment structures, and supplier agreements
* Financial analysis skills including Total Cost of Ownership modeling and basic cash flow concepts applied to supplier agreements

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Business Consultant COE
description:
**Job Description**
The Business Consultant will be part of the Honeywell AutonomyX Center of Excellence (CoE) based in Pune, India, and will play an active role in developing and executing business consulting activities for Middle East, Turkey, and Central Asia (META) region opportunities, with flexibility to engage other regions depending on workload. This role will combine selective front-office ownership of qualified customer opportunities with back-office business development, analysis, proposal, and value-storyline execution in partnership with the Middle East business consulting team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Business development and selective opportunity leadership for META digital transformation programs for operating companies:
* Co-lead opportunity development for Honeywell AutonomyX and related transformation programs across META, working closely with the Middle East business consulting lead and regional sales teams, including

+ Research customer operating models, business priorities, performance improvement levers, and digital/autonomy transformation opportunities
+ Translate customer challenges into structured consulting problem statements linked to Honeywell and AutonomyX solutions
+ Own preparation of executive engagement materials, value hypotheses, customer narratives, and account-specific storylines for selected pursuits
+ Lead or actively participate in selected customer-facing discussions and workshops, including preparation, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up from Pune or on site when required
+ Own customer-ready material including value propositions, executive summaries, business cases, case studies, and sales enablement content for assigned opportunities
+ Lead preparation and follow-through for selected regional demonstrations, conferences, campaigns, and strategic pursuits

* Drive go-to-market planning inputs, account prioritization, white-space analysis, customer segmentation for Honeywell AutonomyX and Process Automation
* Consulting workshops, studies and execution ownership
* Lead or co-lead scoping of customer diagnostic exercises, workshops, value assessments, and consulting studies for selected META opportunities
* Develop consulting proposals, workshop agendas, data request lists, workplans, interview guides, and analysis frameworks with appropriate regional input
* Coordinate and drive inputs from technical, sales, and solution teams to produce structured consulting deliverables
* Own the development of diagnostic reports, gap analyses, business cases, value roadmaps, maturity assessments, and adoption plans for assigned workstreams
* Drive follow-up actions, maintain opportunity documentation, and lead handover from consulting discovery into sales execution where assigned
* CoE capability building and organizational enablement
* Build and continuously improve repeatable AutonomyX consulting assets, templates, value frameworks, and proposal content within the Pune CoE
* Lead selected internal enablement activities for value-based selling and consulting-led opportunity development across META
* Share best practices, case studies, and reusable methods with regional sales, consulting, and solution teams

**Qualifications**
**Skills and qualifications**

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school
* Prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, refining, petrochemicals, or other process industries preferred
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical engineering discipline preferred; Chemical Engineering is desirable, although other relevant engineering disciplines will be considered
* Preferred experience in running or contributing to operational transformation programs, performance improvement initiatives, digital transformation programs, or operating model improvement efforts
* Demonstrated ability to lead defined consulting workstreams, customer workshops, or opportunity development activities with senior stakeholder exposure
* Strong written communication and executive-presentation preparation skills, with ability to create clear customer-facing narratives and C-suite-ready materials
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to structure ambiguous business problems, identify customer value levers, and translate analysis into actionable recommendations
* Strong quantitative skills, including business case development, financial modelling, scenario planning, benchmarking, and value analysis
* Ability to work effectively from Pune with META stakeholders across time zones, balancing independent ownership, remote collaboration, and selected customer-facing engagement
* Ability to travel to Middle East selectively for high-value customer workshops, internal alignment sessions, and strategic pursuits as required

**Value proposition of role**

* Opportunity to help shape the AutonomyX CoE in Pune while taking ownership of selected strategic growth opportunities in the META region
* Blend of customer-facing consulting leadership and high-impact strategy, proposal, analysis, and execution ownership
* High visibility to regional business consulting, sales, and leadership teams through direct contribution to priority transformation pursuits
* Exposure to globally leading operating companies in the Middle East that are at the forefront of technology transformation, autonomy, and next-generation industrial operations
* Strong platform to develop expertise in autonomy, digital transformation, industrial operations, and value-based selling
* Role offers a broad problem-solving, business case, and opportunity-leadership remit across multiple industries and customer situations
* Selective travel intensity compared with pure front-office consulting, while retaining meaningful ownership of strategic customer engagements

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

:

**Job Description**
The Senior Specialist, Risk Modeling role sits within BNY’s largest modeling organization. The successful candidate will join the Economic Capital Modeling team, supporting ICAAP/ICARA processes and providing end-to-end support for models that inform key management decisions and are regularly reported to Senior Management and the Board of Directors.
  
  
This role is expected to be performed in adherence with corporate-wide standards for model development and industry best practices. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying problems that can be addressed through the application of financial theory and quantitative methods, including evaluating and selecting appropriate modeling frameworks and determining the scope of solutions. * Develop and implement modeling solutions in line with technical direction, ensuring the accuracy and soundness of quantitative methods within the assigned area.
* Conduct independent research and data analysis to address stakeholder inquiries and support decision-making.
* Support senior modelers in both business-as-usual activities and longer-term strategic projects.
* Apply advanced AI tools to streamline, enhance, and automate processes where appropriate.
* Engage directly with stakeholders to understand needs, communicate findings, and provide modeling support.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following**

* Master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline such as engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or economics.
* Strong theoretical foundation combined with solid programming, documentation, and communication skills.
* At least 1 year of modeling-related experience, preferably in financial services.
* Experience with stochastic processes, numerical analysis, and computational methods using programming languages, preferably Python, as well as mathematical and statistical software packages.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks and a strong commitment to responsible AI use.
* Strong attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a highly focused, analytical mindset.

description:

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. **Job summary**

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst – GTM FP&A to join our Finance organization. This role will report directly to the VP of FP&A and will play a key role in supporting the company’s GTM planning, reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

The ideal candidate has strong financial modeling and analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex SaaS performance data into clear and concise reporting for senior leadership.

This role will have significant exposure to ARR, bookings, revenue, billings, churn, renewals, expansions, contractions, and retention metrics, with a particular focus on building and maintaining reporting models and executive-level reporting decks.

The position will be based in India and will work closely with Finance leadership in both India and the U.S. The role will also have a dotted-line relationship with the Director of Finance – India. 

**What you will do**

**SaaS Topline Reporting & Analysis**

Own and maintain recurring reporting for key SaaS topline metrics, including:

* + ARR
  + Bookings
  + Billings
  + Revenue
  + Dollar-based Gross Retention (GRR)
  + Dollar-based Net Retention (NRR)
  + Churn
  + Contraction
  + Expansion
  + New business
* Analyze monthly and quarterly performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
* Identify key drivers and variances within the SaaS topline and clearly communicate findings to Finance leadership.
* Maintain detailed customer and cohort-level analyses to support understanding of topline performance.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency of topline data across reporting models and management reporting.

**Financial Modeling & Forecasting**

* Build, maintain, and enhance financial models supporting SaaS topline forecasting and planning.
* Develop detailed models for ARR movements, customer retention, churn, contraction, expansion, and new business.
* Support monthly forecasting and annual planning processes.
* Perform scenario analysis and sensitivity analysis to evaluate different topline assumptions and business outcomes.
* Develop analytical models to help Finance leadership understand trends, risks, and opportunities within the SaaS business.
* Improve and automate existing models and reporting processes where appropriate.

**Management Reporting & Executive Presentations**

* Prepare recurring reporting packages and executive-level presentations for Finance and senior leadership.
* Build and maintain reporting decks highlighting topline performance, key trends, and variance drivers.
* Translate detailed financial and operational data into clear, concise insights for senior audiences.
* Support preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews.
* Ensure reporting materials are accurate, timely, and presented in a clear and executive-friendly format.

**What you will have**

* **3+ years of experience**
  in FP&A, financial analysis, corporate finance, or a similar analytical role.
* Strong experience with
  **financial modeling, forecasting, and management reporting**
  .
* Experience working in a
  **SaaS or recurring-revenue business**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of SaaS financial and operating metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, expansion, and contraction.
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills with the ability to build complex financial models.
* Strong PowerPoint / presentation skills and experience creating executive-level reporting decks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to work with large datasets and translate detailed analysis into clear business insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work within tight deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with financial planning systems, BI tools, Salesforce, NetSuite, or similar systems is a plus.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Strong financial modeling skills**
  with a focus on building scalable, accurate models.
* **Exceptional attention to detail**
  and a high level of ownership over reporting accuracy.
* Someone who enjoys working with data and can quickly identify trends, anomalies, and key drivers.
* Strong ability to create
  **clear, polished reporting decks**
  for senior leadership.
* A self-starter who can operate independently while knowing when to escalate issues.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain financial concepts clearly.
* A mindset focused on continuously improving models, reporting, and processes.

**Reporting Structure**

This position will
**report directly to the VP of FP&A**
and will be based in India.

The role will also have a
**dotted-line reporting relationship to the Director of Finance – India**
, providing additional alignment with the broader India Finance organization.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will include:

* Accurate and timely SaaS topline reporting.
* High-quality financial models that support forecasting and planning.
* Clear and insightful executive reporting decks.
* Strong understanding and analysis of ARR and retention movements.

**Benefits**

* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support

description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
**Senior Treasury Accountant**
AB Finco — International In-House Bank | Cencora
  
  
**Business Unit**
Cencora International Controlling — ABFinco Operations
  
  
**Reporting Line**
Treasury Accounting Lead
  
  
**Level**
Senior Accountant
  
  
**Location**
Pune, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Contract Type**
Permanent, Full-Time
  
  
**Key Interfaces**
Group Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, Shared Service Centre and Banking Partners
  
  
**About Cencora & Abfinco**
Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) is a Fortune 10 global pharmaceutical distribution and solutions company operating in more than 65 countries. ABFinco is Cencora’s international in-house bank, providing central cash pooling, foreign exchange and intercompany funding services to international businesses including Alliance Healthcare, World Courier and PharmaLex. ABFinco manages exposures in more than 10 active currencies.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Senior Treasury Accountant will deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled accounting for ABFinco’s foreign exchange, intercompany lending and cash activities. The role owns treasury accounting from transaction capture in Kyriba through posting and reconciliation in SAP, leads the monthly close, and provides quality review and technical support to Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts. Reporting to the Treasury Accounting Lead, the role will also strengthen controls, reporting and processes as the in-house treasury accounting function develops.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Treasury Accounting and Close**

* Own accounting for FX, hedging, cash and intercompany treasury transactions in Kyriba and SAP.
* Review treasury entries, valuations and interest accruals.
* Lead the monthly close and deliver accurate management accounts and treasury reporting between workday 1 and workday 3.
* Reconcile Kyriba to SAP, resolve differences and maintain complete supporting documentation.
* Support hedge-accounting calculations, statutory reporting, Group consolidation and internal and external audits.

**Intercompany Loans And Cash**

* Oversee accounting and reconciliation for intercompany loans, cash pools and Group funding balances across 102 entities.
* Review loan interest, reference rates and margins against agreements and transfer-pricing requirements.
* Prepare and review loan, cash and bank reconciliation reports.

**Controls and Systems**

* Operate treasury-accounting controls, maintain audit evidence and support control testing.
* Maintain treasury-system master data and support Kyriba-to-SAP interfaces, reporting and process improvements.
* Support regulatory reporting and ensure transactions comply with internal policies and segregation-of-duties requirements.

**Team and Stakeholder Support**

* Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.
* Work with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, banking partners and international finance teams to resolve issues and support change.

**Essential**
**PROFILE & SKILLS**

* Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant, ACCA or equivalent finance qualification, with 4–7 years of relevant treasury accounting experience.
* Practical experience of month-end close, reconciliations, FX accounting and intercompany accounting.
* Hands-on experience with an ERP or treasury management system; SAP or Kyriba exposure is preferred.

Strong analytical, reconciliation and control skills, with attention to detail in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
  
  

* Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills across Treasury, Finance, Tax, Legal and IT.
* Ability to review work, coach colleagues and manage priorities in a Shared Service Centre environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a multinational treasury, in-house bank or treasury shared-services environment.
* Knowledge of cash pooling, intercompany funding and hedge accounting under IFRS 9 or ASC 815.
* Exposure to Kyriba, SAP, Bloomberg, or trade-confirmation platforms.
* Treasury qualification or relevant professional development is desirable.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in accounting, financial operations, reconciliations, close support, reporting support, or a related field required. Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or equivalent certification preferred. Knowledge of accounting principles, including cost accounting and financial statement analysis. Working knowledge of accounting software and ERP systems; SAP experience is preferred. Ability to create clear, user-tailored financial reports. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Strong mathematical, analytical, and fact-based analysis skills with attention to detail. Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrates management and supervisory skills. Ability to implement processes that support satisfactory audit practices. Knowledge of contract and chargeback processes, credit and collection principles, and business law. Ability to work independently and handle stressful situations.

description:

In the MEP industry, projects move fast and require a mix of technical precision and commercial savvy. You will act as the "right hand" to the leadership, helping transition the firm from engineering concepts to market-leading execution. This role is perfect for a fresh graduate who wants to see the "business side" of engineering early in their career.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Market Research & MEP Trends: Research emerging technologies like BIM (Building Information Modeling), sustainable HVAC solutions, and IoT-integrated electrical systems to keep the firm competitive.
* Business Development & Tendering: Assist in preparing technical bids and commercial proposals. You will help identify new "Greenfield" and "Brownfield" project opportunities in the commercial and industrial sectors.
* Financial & Project Modeling: Support the founder in project cost estimation, resource allocation modeling, and tracking the profitability of ongoing MEP contracts.
* Graphic Design & Branding: Take ownership of the firm’s visual identity. You will design brand decks, technical brochures, and high-impact project portfolios for client meetings.
* Data Analytics: Analyze project timelines and labor costs to identify bottlenecks, providing the founder with data-driven reports to improve operational efficiency.

**The Profile we are looking for**

* Educational Background: A recent degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (preferred) or Business/Architecture with a strong interest in the built environment.
* The "Swiss Army Knife" Mindset: You are equally comfortable reading a technical floor plan as you are designing a logo or building a spreadsheet.
* Software Savvy:
* Engineering: Awareness of AutoCAD or Revit (BIM) is a plus.
* Design: Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Illustrator or Figma.
* Data: Advanced Excel skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, basic macros).
* Tech: Proficient in using AI technology to generate results.
* Communication: Exceptional writing skills to draft "Nearby Engineers" style documentation and professional correspondence.

**What is in it for you?**

* Direct Mentorship: Work daily with the Founder, gaining insights that usually take 10 years to acquire.
* Holistic Growth: Develop a rare profile that combines engineering logic with business development and creative design.
* Impact: Your research and designs will be the face of the firm in front of developers and architects.

This is a dynamic role, beyond the listed responsibilities, you will be expected to step in and own any high-priority tasks as needed.

title: Procurement Risk Analyst
description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
* Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
* Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.
* Monitor supplier capacity, continuity of supply, reputational risks, and margin-related risks, and proactively implement risk mitigation strategies.
* Prepare and present recommendations for process improvements, risk reduction opportunities, and alternative courses of action to procurement leadership.
* Support procurement operations related to supplier onboarding, qualification, contract management, payment issues, and order fulfillment.
* Serve as the communication conduit between suppliers, sourcing teams, and manufacturing facilities during supplier issues or disruptions.
* Provide delivery and expediting support to plants/sites during supplier constraints or operational challenges.
* Support management and execution of engineering releases impacting suppliers.
* Collect, validate, and maintain supplier scorecard data and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Act as a Data Steward by ensuring data integrity, governance, quality, and consistency across procurement systems.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
* Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
* Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
* Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
* Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
* Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
* Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.
* Supplier Performance Management: Ability to monitor supplier KPIs, manage corrective actions, and drive continuous supplier improvement.
* Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
* Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.
* Problem Solving: Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving using data-driven methodologies.
* Negotiation Excellence: Ability to support negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial business outcomes.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
* Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
* Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, supplier management, or source-to-pay operations.
* Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
* Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
* Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global or matrix organizations.
* Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments preferred.

**Additional Information**

* Work Location: Cummins India Technical Center (IOC), Pune, India
* Shift Timing: Afternoon / EMEA Shift (12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST)
* Work Mode: Hybrid / On-site with flexibility

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
* Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, with specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations.
* Additional certifications in Risk Management, Procurement, Project Management (PMP/Prince2), or Data Analytics are an advantage.

**JOB OVERVIEW**
Legion is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive disciplined planning, forecasting and decision support across a growing SaaS business. This role will own assigned forecasts and reporting, build scalable financial models, analyze financial and operating performance, and translate findings into clear recommendations for leaders.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong FP&A fundamentals with commercial judgment, comfort working with SaaS metrics and systems, and the ability to partner effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist Financial Planning and Analysis Director in managing the strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Own designated components of the annual budget, periodic forecasts and long-range plan, including assumptions, scenario analysis and consolidation support.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models for revenue, headcount, operating expenses, pricing, investments and strategic initiatives
* Deep understanding of SaaS financial and operational KPIs, a strong ability to analyze data to identify trends, actual performance against budget, forecast, prior periods risks, opportunities for growth. Monitor key KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly management reporting, dashboards, executive presentations and decision-support materials.
* Investigate revenue, cost, margin, and operational variances and explain key business drivers.
* Partner with business functions to evaluate performance and support commercial decisions.
* Perform profitability, pricing, cost-benefit, ROI, sensitivity and ad hoc analyses to support business cases and investment decisions.
* Support month-end and quarter-end closing activities in coordination with accounting teams by reviewing results, validating data and resolving reporting discrepancies.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity of financial data and reports through standardization, automation and effective use of finance systems.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls, documentation and data integrity, and support audit or compliance requests related to assigned work.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA is required or relevant professional qualification is preferred
* 5+ years of experience in in FP&A, strategic finance, business finance or a closely related analytical finance role in a SaaS, enterprise-software company
* Proficiency with NetSuite required;
* Advanced financial modelling skills, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

title: Senior Financial Planner & Analyst
description:
FP&A / Business Finance
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a finance professional who can own planning, forecasting, management reporting, business analysis, working capital, and financial modelling in a high-growth environment.
  
  
We hire on
**demonstrated capability, not on credentials**
. The role requires strong financial ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Planning & Forecasting
* Own the annual operating plan, a rolling 12-month forecast, and driver-based models and business plans built on volumes, pricing, bill-of-material cost and headcount, not last year plus a percentage.
* Management Reporting & MIS
* Own the monthly pack for both entities and the consolidation, covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPIs and cost centres.
* Prepare sales and cost performance reporting, delivered to a fixed working day.
* Dashboards & Business Reporting
* Build and maintain CEO, CFO, functional-head and investor dashboards.
* Ensure one definition per metric, with controls that prove the numbers tie.
* Cash, Working Capital & Treasury
* Own the cash position statement and short-term cash forecast.
* Track receivables and payables ageing and collections, inventory ageing, DSO / DIO / DPO.
* Manage treasury and investment valuation summaries, along with the overall liquidity and runway view.
* Variance Analysis
* Perform budget vs actual, forecast vs actual, month-on-month and year-on-year analysis.
* Decompose variances into volume, rate and mix.
* Provide the cause, impact and recommended action — not just the number.
* Unit Economics & Pricing
* Analyse profitability by product, segment, customer and geography.
* Build cost structures from bill of material to commissioning.
* Provide deal-level margin support.
* Develop capital-expenditure and make-versus-buy business cases.
* Board, Investor & Fundraising Support
* Support the financial sections of the board pack and investor MIS.
* Build the models, scenarios and diligence data required for a fundraise.
* Market & Competitive Insight
* Conduct market sizing and demand analysis.

description:
****Responsibilities****
**What Makes This Opportunity Unique**
At Principal Financial Group, we pride ourselves on delivering world-class financial solutions and services. As an Assistant Manager - Client Reporting, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring flawless execution of client reporting and portfolio performance analysis. You will lead a motivated team, direct operations, and have the opportunity to collaborate with top-tier professionals both within our organization and externally. * Apply strong controls and standard operating procedures to meet regulatory and operational expectations; track metrics and drive continuous improvement.
* Understand front-to-back data flows; work alongside Information Technology (IT) to resolve data issues and stabilize/report through structured huddles and check-ins.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Client and performance reporting activities (35%)
* Plan and coordinate daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly reporting production; ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery according to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain control evidence, exception logs, and approvals; ensure consistent templates and disclosures.
* People leadership and development (30%)
* Mentor, develop, and motivate team members; provide timely feedback and objective performance evaluations.
* Define roles, delegate work with measurable objectives, manage coverage, and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
* Collaborator partnership and communication (15%)
* Build positive relationships with head office and boutique collaborators; communicate status, risks, and decisions transparently.
* Manage conflicts constructively; ensure clear handoffs with Shared Services and external partners.
* Process improvement, metrics, and planning (10%)
* Contribute to planning and operating model improvements; identify low-value work and streamline workflows.
* Use metrics, huddles, and check-ins to monitor efficiency, quality, and capacity; recommend resource adjustments.
* Risk, compliance, and decision-making (5%)
* Apply operational and regulatory procedures; perform root cause analysis for issues and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Advance material risks promptly with recommended options.
* Data flow and systems collaboration (5%)
* Chart front-to-back data flows; collaborate with IT and business data owners to address breaks and implement alternative solutions that satisfy reporting goals.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, or business (or equivalent) with 10–12 years of experience in investment, asset management, mutual fund operations, or a related field.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, relationship building, delegation, and presentation skills; diligent and adaptable in changing (VUCA) environments.
* Able to prioritize, make sound decisions, and deliver consistent results under deadlines; open to feedback and continuous improvement.
* Tools/Tech: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word; collaboration tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams); data visualization (Power BI); performance/reporting platforms (Eagle, Factset); workflow/ticketing tools (JIRA); document repositories (e.g., SharePoint or TBD).

****Skills That Help You To Stand Out:****

* Demonstrated leadership in client and performance reporting operations with quantifiable SLA achievement and quality results.
* Expertise in mentoring teams, setting measurable objectives, and using data-focused huddles/check-ins to manage efficiency and quality.
* Ability to identify data issues throughout front-to-back flows and collaborate with IT to apply lasting solutions.
* Track record in simplifying processes, eliminating low-value work, and scaling standard templates and controls across boutiques/Shared Services.
* Strong approach to handling blocking issues with clear problem statements, root causes, and recommended options.

**Shift Timings: 1.30PM to 10.30PM**

title: Senior Associates – Balance Sheet and Control CoE
description:
**Job Description**

The Senior Accounting Control Associate is responsible for driving the organization's financial governance and control framework through the execution, oversight and continuous enhancement of key accounting controls. This role provides advanced support across balance sheet reconciliations, ASC 606 revenue recognition compliance, journal entry governance, SOX controls, audit readiness, and financial close processes.

The role requires strong analytical capabilities, the ability to independently manage complex accounting control activities, identify and mitigate financial risks and partner with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen the overall control environment. The Senior Associate is also expected to lead process improvement initiatives, mentor junior team members and support management in ensuring compliance with accounting standards, internal policies and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Balance Sheet Reconciliations & Account Governance

* Lead the preparation and review of complex balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely completion.

* Perform detailed analysis of high-risk and critical accounts, identifying trends, anomalies, and potential control concerns.

* Drive resolution of aged reconciling items and collaborate with business stakeholders to remediate issues.

* Monitor compliance with reconciliation policies, governance standards, and control requirements.

* Support management reviews and provide insights on account integrity and financial risk exposure.

* Coach and guide team members on reconciliation best practices and quality standards.

2. Revenue Recognition Controls (ASC 606)

* Execute and oversee revenue recognition control activities in compliance with ASC 606 and company policies.

* Review complex revenue transactions and supporting documentation to ensure accurate accounting treatment.

* Assess and investigate revenue-related risks, exceptions and control gaps, driving timely remediation.

* Partner with Revenue Assurance, Finance, Commercial, and Controllership teams to ensure compliance and operational effectiveness.

* Support implementation of new revenue recognition requirements, process changes, and control enhancements.

* Provide subject matter expertise on revenue control matters and assist with issue resolution.

3. Journal Entry Governance & Financial Close

* Review and approve journal entries for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting policies.

* Coordinate and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities to ensure timely reporting.

* Monitor close performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.

* Ensure appropriate documentation, review evidence and control execution are maintained throughout the close cycle.

* Support resolution of complex accounting issues impacting financial reporting and close processes.

* Assist management in driving a robust financial close governance framework.

4. SOX Compliance, IPE & Audit Management

* Execute and oversee SOX controls and Information Produced by the Entity (IPE) validation procedures.

* Maintain audit-ready documentation and ensure control evidence meets internal and external audit requirements.

* Coordinate responses to audit requests and support walkthroughs, testing and remediation activities.

* Identify control deficiencies, recommend corrective actions and track remediation to closure.

* Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Compliance and Controllership teams to strengthen governance practices.

* Contribute to risk assessments and the continuous enhancement of the control environment.

5. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and enhance control dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting to support governance oversight.

* Perform trend analysis and identify emerging risks, control exceptions and improvement opportunities.

* Lead automation and process optimization initiatives utilizing technology and reporting tools.

* Drive standardization of processes, documentation and control execution across operating units.

* Support implementation of best practices related to controllership, compliance and financial governance.

* Recommend and implement improvements that enhance efficiency, control effectiveness, and reporting quality.

6. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Serve as a key point of contact for finance, controllership, audit, and business stakeholders.

* Provide guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to junior associates and new team members.

* Lead small projects and improvement initiatives with minimal supervision.

* Support managers in strategic controllership and governance programs.

* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

* 5-8 years of experience in accounting, controllership, financial controls, audit, SOX compliance, or financial governance functions.

* Strong knowledge of US GAAP, ASC 606 revenue recognition requirements and SOX compliance frameworks.

* Proven experience supporting month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial reporting processes.

* Experience working with internal and external auditors in a regulated environment.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, influence outcomes, and deliver under tight deadlines.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

* Experience working in a multinational, publicly traded, or SOX-regulated organization.

* Advanced experience with:

* OneStream (Account Reconciliations and Controls)

* SAP (General Ledger, Journal Entries, Financial Reporting)

* Advanced Microsoft Excel & Power BI, Alteryx, or similar reporting and automation tools

* Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, risk management, and governance practices.

* Knowledge of emerging technologies and automation solutions in finance and controllership functions.

**Additional Information**
