**About Evora IT Solutions \& Evora Service Partner**
 Evora IT Solutions Group is a global SAP partner delivering innovative IT services and solutions. As part of our growth strategy, we are establishing the Evora Service Partner Centre (“Evora Service Partner”) — an unified, centralised function supporting all Evora entities globally under a single operating model. Phase 1 of Evora Service Partner will serve our Germany and USA entities, with a clear expansion roadmap to additional regions.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Finance Lead – Evora Service Partner is a senior individual contributor and team lead role based in India, forming part of Evora Group's shared finance delivery model. The role sits within the Evora Service Partner (ESP) organisation in India and operates as a dedicated finance function supporting Evora Group's global entities.
   

  

 You will lead a team of finance professionals in India who provide shared finance services — including general ledger accounting, financial reporting, and process operations — to Evora Group entities globally. While your day\-to\-day employment and people management are with the ESP Head in India, your finance work is directed by and closely aligned with the Global Finance Lead, ensuring full integration with Evora Group's global finance function.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role for a finance professional who combines technical depth in accounting with a service\-delivery mindset, the ability to build trusted cross\-cultural working relationships, and the drive to lead a team delivering excellence from India to the world.
   

  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in accounting/finance, with strong exposure to multi\-entity international environments.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a team lead or managerial capacity within a Shared Services Centre (SSC).
* Strong expertise in accounting standards: IFRS and HGB; local GAAP knowledge a plus.
* Deep understanding of month\-end close, balance sheet management, and consolidated financial reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP (S/4HANA or SAP Cloud ERP an advantage).
* Proven track record collaborating with senior global stakeholders and cross\-border teams.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* Fluent English (written and spoken) essential; German language skills a strong advantage.
* Practical experience applying AI tools in a finance or shared services context.
* Proven ability to coach teams on new ways of working; comfortable as an informal AI champion.
* Grounded understanding of responsible AI use: data sensitivity, compliance boundaries, and appropriate human oversight.


**What You Bring**
**Shared Finance Service Delivery**
* Lead the delivery of high\-quality, SLA\-driven finance services from the India team to Evora Group global entities.
* Ensure all deliverables — reporting, reconciliations, close activities — are completed accurately, on time, and to the standard set by the Global Finance Lead.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between the India\-based finance team and the global finance function.
* Monitor service quality, proactively flag issues, and drive resolution in coordination with the Global Finance Lead.


**General Ledger Ownership \& Accounting Excellence**
* End\-to\-end ownership of GL processes for Evora Group international entities supported from India.
* Ensure accurate and timely month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close (HGB, IFRS, applicable local GAAPs).
* Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Drive strong accounting practices across AP, AR, fixed assets, and intercompany accounting.
* Maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and ongoing audit readiness across all entities served.


**Financial Reporting \& Compliance**
* Prepare and review financial statements in line with HGB, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.
* Support group consolidation and reporting processes in close collaboration with the Global Finance Lead.
* Act as a key liaison for internal and external audits across entities served from India.
* Ensure compliance with tax, regulatory, and governance requirements across jurisdictions.


**Team Leadership within the Shared Service Model**
* Lead, coordinate, and develop the India\-based finance team delivering global finance services.
* Set clear task priorities and workload plans aligned to global finance calendars and deadlines.
* Foster a high\-quality, service\-oriented team culture focused on accuracy, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
* Support team capability development in coordination with the ESP Head and Global Finance Lead.


**Global Finance Collaboration**
* Work closely and proactively with the Global Finance Lead to receive direction, align on priorities, and report on delivery.
* Collaborate with onshore finance teams (Germany HQ and other regional offices) to ensure seamless, aligned service delivery.
* Provide technical accounting guidance and act as a subject matter expert to global finance stakeholders.
* Participate in global finance meetings, planning cycles, and cross\-entity initiatives as required.


**Process Standardisation, Automation \& Transformation**
* Lead standardisation and harmonisation of finance processes across all entities supported from India.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement in closing, reconciliation, and reporting workflows.
* Actively contribute to group\-wide finance transformation initiatives, including SAP Cloud ERP rollout.
* Ensure data integrity, chart of accounts consistency, and strong data governance across entities.


**Systems \& Technology**
* Champion effective ERP usage (SAP preferred) with focus on GL and accounting modules.
* Support implementation, testing, and optimisation of finance tools and platforms.


**AI\-First Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Champion an AI\-first mindset within the India finance team — not as a technology project, but as a fundamental shift in how the team works, delivers, and grows.
* Model and embed AI\-driven ways of working across close, reporting, and reconciliation processes — from automation of routine tasks to AI\-assisted analysis and commentary.
* Coach team members to use AI as a force multiplier: sharpening human judgment rather than replacing it.
* Identify practical AI leverage points that compress cycle times, reduce manual effort, and raise output quality.
* Set clear guardrails: ensure AI usage stays within Evora's compliance and data classification policies, and that human accountability is maintained where it matters.
* Stay current on AI developments relevant to finance; bring actionable recommendations to the Global Finance Lead.


**What We Offer**
**Our Values** 
 – Collaboration, Commitment, Evolution, Entrepreneurship, Happiness, and Trust form the foundation of our organization and guide the way we work and grow together.
   

  

**Company Culture** 
 – We foster a collaborative environment where teams work together in integrated virtual teams to serve our customers effectively. We are committed to sharing our success with employees through a strong workplace culture and financial participation.

Role Overview: The General Manager (GM) is responsible for end\-to\-end management of the resort, including administration, day\-to\-day operations, legal and statutory compliance, guest experience, and business growth. The GM will work closely with the owners/management to execute innovative ideas that enhance revenue, profitability, and brand positioning of the resort. Key Responsibilities: 1\. Overall Resort Administration. Lead and manage all departments: Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Spa/Activities, Security, Engineering, Finance, HR and Stores.
 


* Develop and implement SOPs for all operational areas to ensure consistency, efficiency and high service standards.
* Set annual and monthly operational targets and monitor performance against KPIs (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction, costs, etc.).



  





 2\. Day\-to\-Day OperationsOversee daily operations to ensure smooth functioning of the resort across all shifts.
 


* Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and maintain high standards of cleanliness, safety, and guest service.
* Conduct daily/weekly departmental review meetings and ensure coordination between teams.
* Monitor procurement, inventory and cost control for food, beverages, linens, amenities and other supplies.



  





 3\. Legal, Licensing and Statutory ComplianceEnsure all licenses and registrations (hospitality, FSSAI, liquor, local tourism, pollution control, fire safety, music/entertainment, etc.) are valid, renewed on time and properly documented.
 


* Ensure compliance with local, state and national laws related to labour, wages, ESI, PF, safety and environmental norms.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, chartered accountants and company secretaries to maintain statutory records and filings.
* Handle inspections, audits and visits from government or regulatory authorities, ensuring full cooperation and zero non\-compliance.



  





 4\. Financial Management and ProfitabilityPrepare and manage annual budgets, forecasts and monthly MIS reports in coordination with Finance.
 


* Track revenue streams (rooms, F\&B, banquets, events, activities, spa, ancillary services) and drive strategies to increase yield and profitability.
* Implement cost\-control measures without compromising guest experience and brand standards.
* Review P\&L statements regularly and recommend corrective actions to management.



  





 5\. Revenue Growth, Sales \& Marketing SupportCollaborate with the sales and marketing team/agency on room packages, events, retreats, weddings, conferences and other offerings to boost occupancy and average rates.
 


* Support digital marketing and OTA strategies (website, social media, Google, booking portals) by providing inputs on promotions, guest stories, visual content and campaigns.
* Build and maintain relationships with travel agents, corporates, event planners and local partners to drive business.
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends and guest feedback to refine pricing and positioning.



  





 6\. Innovation, Business Renovation \& Brand BuildingWork with management to identify and execute innovative, creative ideas to upgrade the resort’s product, services and experiences (e.g., themed experiences, wellness retreats, eco\-friendly initiatives, local cultural programs).
 


* Plan and oversee renovation, refurbishment and modernization projects in coordination with architects, vendors and contractors.
* Introduce new revenue streams (activities, curated experiences, memberships, partnerships, merchandise, etc.) aligned with the brand.
* Ensure the resort aligns with a clear brand story and guest value proposition, and that this is reflected in service, décor, communication and guest interactions.



  




* 7\. Guest Experience and Service QualityEnsure a guest\-centric culture in the resort, with consistent, warm and professional service.
* Personally handle VIP guests, important groups and escalated complaints to ensure quick resolution and delight.
* Monitor guest feedback from all channels (in\-person, feedback forms, online reviews) and convert insights into action plans.
* Implement training and coaching for staff on hospitality standards, communication, grooming and guest handling.



  





 8\. People Leadership \& CultureLead by example and build a high\-performance, accountable, and collaborative culture in the resort.
 


* Oversee recruitment, onboarding and training of staff across levels, in coordination with HR.
* Design and implement staff schedules, performance reviews, rewards and disciplinary actions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, policies on POSH, and a safe, respectful workplace for all employees.



  





 9\. Safety, Security and Risk ManagementEnsure implementation of health, safety and hygiene protocols across the property.
 


* Oversee security arrangements for guests, staff and property assets.
* Develop and periodically review emergency and crisis management plans (fire, medical emergencies, natural disasters, etc.).
* Ensure regular maintenance of all equipment, infrastructure and facilities to minimize breakdowns and risks.



  





 10\. Reporting and Stakeholder ManagementProvide regular updates to promoters/owners on operations, financials, projects and risk areas.
 


* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly performance reports with key insights and recommendations.

title: Manager - Strategic Buyer (L09)
description:
**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4 \- 5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or in lieu of a degree 6 \-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.


**Work Timings: 04:00 PM – 01:00 AM IST**
 (WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

**Description \& Requirements**
 Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology \- quickly and accurately. We apply problem\-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes \- all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.
   

  

**Our Team**
 The Company Financials team provides clients with fast and accurate market\-moving data covering broker estimates, financial filings, and other critical datasets that help them assess financial performance. We use financial modeling, industry expertise, data management, and technical skills to curate key metrics and extract insights from our data. Our goal is to deliver a best\-in\-class financial analysis and modeling product while continuously expanding and enhancing our offering.
   

  

 Across Company Financials Data, we are focused on building scalable, observable, and AI\-ready data operations. This includes redesigning workflows, improving process efficiency, embedding automation, and ensuring that financial data is delivered with the quality, consistency, and timeliness our clients expect.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Company Financials Process Automation \& Data Operations team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Management Professional to drive operational excellence across financial data workflows. You will leverage data, automation, and process improvement expertise to optimize production, enhance quality and controls, reduce manual effort, and scale AI\-ready workflows. Partnering with Workflow, Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams, you will deliver solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and client outcomes.
   

  

**We'll Trust You To**
* Analyze workflows and production data to identify bottlenecks, quality risks, and automation opportunities, delivering scalable improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency
* Partner with Workflow, Product, Engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to implement workflow, automation, and operational enhancements
* Build monitoring, reporting, quality control, governance, and exception management frameworks that improve visibility, oversight, and operational resilience
* Perform root cause analysis on production issues and develop sustainable solutions that reduce recurring operational risks
* Leverage SQL, Python, ETL/ELT frameworks, GenAI tools, and automation technologies to optimize data acquisition, transformation, validation, and AI\-ready workflows
* Measure and report on operational performance, automation benefits, and process improvement outcomes
* Act as a subject matter expert and mentor, promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement across the organization


**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or a related STEM field (or equivalent experience)
* 4\+ years of experience in data operations, process improvement, workflow automation, and data governance, including data quality management, metadata management, and operational controls
* Strong technical proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation workflows, and data visualization or workflow monitoring tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI), with knowledge of data observability, data quality monitoring, and production controls
* Experience identifying inefficiencies and delivering measurable improvements through process optimization, automation, monitoring, reporting, and operational performance frameworks
* Experience developing and maintaining production\-grade automation solutions using modern software engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and GenAI\-enabled development tools
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross\-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data teams
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English.


**We'd Love To See**
* Experience working with company financials, financial statements, broker estimates, fundamentals, or capital markets data.
* Familiarity with process improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value stream mapping, or similar frameworks.

**About The Role**

 Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state\-of\-the\-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.
   

  

 This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. * Create BI dashboards to drive actionable insights to inform process improvements and reduce financial risks.

title: FS-RC-FSRM - CSTC-FA and R-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.

title: Finance Executive
description:
**Role:** 
 Finance Associate
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India (On\-site, Full\-time)
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Founders
 



  





**About Company** 




 We are a fast\-growing consumer brand built to reduce screen time through interactive products. We are a validated business\-a Shark Tank India alum, venture\-backed by a top family office, and currently expanding into interactive building sets for kidults through our dedicated sub\-brand.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 We are not looking for a traditional record\-keeper. Most of our routine compliance, invoice processing, and daily MIS are already automated into a live dashboard. We need someone to interpret what those numbers mean and guide strategic decisions. As we scale volume and raise capital periodically, our financial data needs to be fast, accurate, and defensible.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* **Statutory \& Compliance:** 
 Bookkeeping, GST filings, and statutory requirements across a multi\-state footprint.
* **Financial Reporting:** 
 The monthly close and MIS pack.
* **Reconciliations:** 
 Marketplace settlements reconciled across every sales channel.
* **Vendor \& CA Management:** 
 Supplier payments and primary coordination with our external CA firm.
* **Diligence \& Automation:** 
 Maintaining a clean data room for investor queries, while continually finding and fixing gaps in our finance automation.



  





**What You Will Grow Into** 




 Working directly with the founders, you will expand your scope into:
 


* Unit economics analysis by channel, category, and SKU.
* Tracking contribution margin leakage, including the true cost of returns and RTO.
* Managing inventory cycles, working capital, and 13\-week rolling cash flows.
* Departmental budgeting, variance analysis, investor reporting, and fundraising diligence.
* **Career Path:** 
 Opportunity to build the finance function from the ground up and grow into the CFO role as the company scales.



  





**Requirements** 



* **AI Tool Fluency (Non\-negotiable):** 
 You naturally reach for AI tools to automate routine tasks and free up time for high\-value judgment work.
* **Background:** 
 Degree in Finance/Accounting (B.Com / M.Com); newly qualified CAs are preferred.
* **Analytical Mindset:** 
 Ability to dig into financial anomalies, pinpoint the root cause, and explain it clearly to non\-finance team members.
* **Bonus:** 
 Hands\-on experience with marketplace settlements and channel reconciliation.



  





**What This Job Is Not** 




 This is a first finance hire, not a seat in a legacy corporate finance team. Compliance is just the baseline\-much of the routine runs itself and your scope will expand as fast as you can handle it.

title: Manager - Credit Risk
description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Manager – Credit Risk to lead credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will combine hands\-on credit expertise, client management, solution development and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong financial analysis and commercial credit underwriting expertise, sound credit judgment, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to translate client requirements into practical processes and solutions.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead delivery of credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements, ensuring quality, timelines and client requirements are met.
* Perform and review financial and credit analysis, including financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flows, liquidity, leverage, profitability, working capital, AR/AP aging and other key credit indicators.
* Monitor credit portfolios and risk trends, identifying emerging risks, changes in financial performance and other indicators requiring attention, and communicate relevant insights to clients.
* Conduct quantitative and qualitative credit assessment, including business model, industry, customer concentration, debt obligations, contracts and supporting documentation, to identify key risks and form a credit view.
* Own client communication and requirement gathering, translating business needs into underwriting frameworks, processes, SOPs and practical risk/technology solutions.
* Manage and develop internal team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and capability building.
* Drive process improvement, standardization, automation and risk\-monitoring initiatives, and proactively communicate key risks, trends and recommendations to clients.



  





 What we are looking for
 


* 5 years of experience in commercial credit risk, financial analysis or risk consulting, preferably within banking, lending, fintech or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, ratio analysis, cash\-flow and working\-capital assessment, with sound credit judgment.
* Strong credit judgment and attention to detail, including ability to identify financial, operational and qualitative risks from multiple information sources.
* Excellent client\-facing, communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to understand ambiguous requirements and develop practical solutions.
* Experience managing/reviewing junior team members and taking ownership of project delivery.
* Experience with process design, SOP development, automation or analytics initiatives.
* Should have strong understanding of Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis/modeling skills.
* Exposure to credit underwriting, financial spreading, banking/transaction data or risk analytics platforms is an advantage.



  





 Educational Qualifications
 


* CA / CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Equivalent qualifications with relevant credit risk/underwriting experience may also be considered.

description:

Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

* Administer procurement workflows within Coupa and NetSuite.

**Process Improvement \& Governance**

 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.

* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700

You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.

* Define and maintain global process and data standards, ownership model, and controls
* Ensure alignment of Master Data across Finance, Customer, Vendor, and Material domains

**Project \& Transformation Leadership**

**Performance \& Continuous Improvement**

+ Process performance (cycle time, cost, efficiency)
+ Master Data quality (accuracy, completeness, timeliness) across all domains

* Drive continuous improvement based on performance insights

**Governance \& Operating Model**

* Enforce standards through governance mechanisms and stakeholder management
* Ensure alignment with regulatory, audit, and control requirements (incl. SOX where applicable)


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with Finance, Sales, Procurement, and Supply Chain leaders to align on process and data ownership
* Drive adoption of global standards and data governance principles
* Resolve cross\-functional conflicts related to process or data decisions
* Report performance, risks, and transformation progress to senior leadership


**Transformation \& Go\-Live Readiness**
* Ensure readiness of RtR and Master Data for system implementations and business transitions
* Oversee data migration, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation
* Ensure cross\-domain data dependencies are managed (customer, vendor, material impacting financial postings)


**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience**
* Experience in GBS / SSC / BPO environment
* 8\+ years in RtR process ownership roles with strong exposure to Master Data governance
* Proven track record leading large\-scale global transformation programs
* Strong experience in:
* Process design and standardization
* Master Data management across Finance, Customer, Vendor, Material
* SAP experience required, including relevant Master Data domains
* Experience in automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement programs
* Understanding of financial controls and impact on reporting


**Additional Qualifications**
* Strong business acumen and ownership mindset
* Ability to drive cross\-functional data ownership and enforce standards
* Strong program and project management capability
* Resilient, proactive, and execution\-focused
* Strong stakeholder and communication skills across matrix organization
* High process and data orientation with focus on integrity, control, and scalability


**About Us**

Whether you’re a finance wizard, a tech enthusiast, an operational powerhouse, an HR changemaker, or a trailblazer in materials development, you’ll find your place at Avient.
   

  

 Join our global team and help shape the future with sustainable solutions that transform possibilities into realities. Your unique perspective could be the key to our next breakthrough!
   

  

 We believe that all of our global employees are leaders and that the six most important behaviors for driving our strategy and culture are the same no matter if an employee is a leader of self, a leader of others, or a leader of the business.

In support of this, we stress equality of opportunity for all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable laws. Decisions on hiring, promotion, development, compensation or advancement are based solely on a person’s qualifications, abilities, experience and performance.

title: Operations and Supply chain Manager

****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contribution
   

  





**Location:** 
 Pune

 The Operational Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end supply chain operations including procurement of manpower services, site specific material, Inventory management, demand planning, supplier management, and customer service. Ensuring effective coordination between site teams, suppliers, and supply chain functions to enable uninterrupted service execution and drive operational efficiency to support business growth
   

  





****Key Responsibilities****




**Manpower Services Procurement**




 Identify, evaluate, and onboard manpower service vendors for service sites across multiple customer locations.
   

  





 Conduct vendor capability, compliance, and commercial evaluations.
   

  





 Negotiate commercial terms and finalize manpower service contracts.
   

  





 Coordinate with Legal for contract vetting, CMS uploading, and timely execution.
   

  





 Manage contract\-related issues and resolve vendor conflicts to ensure continuity of operations.
   

  





 Ensure compliance with statutory, labor, and contractual requirements.

 Identify and develop suppliers for spares and consumables required for site service operations.
   

  





 Coordinate with site and engineering teams to understand material requirements.
   

  





 Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and service levels with suppliers.
   

  





 Monitor supplier performance on cost, quality, and availability.
   

  





 IMS / Inventory / VMI Support (Coordination Role)
   

  





 Support IMS contracts including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) in coordination with site teams, customer service and SKF distributors.
   

  





 Monitor stock levels, consumption trends, and replenishment cycles.
   

  





 Review inventory accuracy between physical stock and SAP records.
   

  





 Support monitoring of IMS KPIs such as stock availability and service fill rate through coordination with site operations.
   

  





**Customer Service \& Supply Chain Transaction Monitoring**




 Monitor job\-related service transactions including material issue and consumption.
   

  





 Track procurement, inventory, and service transactions in SAP systems.
   

  





 Coordinate with Service Execution, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure transactional accuracy and timely closures.
   

  





 Identify transaction gaps or delays and support resolution with operational teams.
   

  





****Qualifications \& Experience****




 Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical preferred) or Commerce / Management.
   

  





 5\-7 years of experience in procurement, service contracts, or supply chain roles within industrial / steel / heavy engineering environments.
   

  





 Strong experience in manpower service contracting and vendor negotiations.
   

  





 Hands\-on exposure to SAP systems for procurement, inventory, and service transactions.
   

  





 Experience working across multiple customer locations and stakeholders.
   

  





**Interested candidates can share their resume to : prachi.chourasia@skf.com**




****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

description:

Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset\-management partner.

Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
   

  

**Describe The Role**
 We are seeking an exceptional individual to support ongoing enhancements to the Vendor Risk Management program through data management, documentation, and engagement with the program framework, processes, and platforms.  The VRMP Analyst will be responsible for executing goals related to process enhancement and vendor inventory enrichment projects primarily through day\-to\-day support tasks. These tasks will include managing vendor data and inventory and supporting the annual vendor due diligence questionnaire exercise. This role would include configuring ProcessUnity, sending the questionnaires, and tracking responses. The candidate will also look for opportunities to improve our operational processes.
   

  

  

  

 Describe the applications and business or enterprise functions the role supports:
   

  

 AB has a long history of adhering to and promoting strong professional ethics and is committed to conducting our business according to the highest standards of honesty and fairness. Assessing and managing Vendor risk is key to delivering on these standards and AB considers topics such as our vendors’ policies and practices for data privacy, cybersecurity, business continuity, ESG, and financial health. The VRMP team provides support to business units and individual vendor relationship managers so they can complete these assessments and mitigate risks appropriately. We manage our vendor inventory in ProcessUnity, execute configuration in ProcessUnity per the process maturation and conduct vendor risk due diligence primarily through an annual due diligence questionnaire exercise. Planned process enhancements include creating intersystem (contract management, accounts payable, CMDB), cross\-functional (Cybersecurity, Modern Slavery, Data Privacy, Business Continuity, Legal \& Compliance, and others) linkages to create a comprehensive risk view of all third\-party engagements.
   

  

 The key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Become system and process Subject Matter Expert (SME) and central support resource for users
* Perform data consolidation and entry tasks
* Create new vendor profiles with key data points and enrich existing profiles
* Support maintenance of data and document repositories according to governance requirements
* Design and configure workflows for various processes such as Inherent Risk Questionnaire, Due Diligence Questionnaire, and overall workflow management in ProcessUnity.


 What is the professional development value of this role, i.e. what learning and professional growth does the role offer the candidate?
   

  

* Opportunity to play a critical role in the evolution of the firm’s Vendor Risk Management program with exposure to senior business and technology stakeholders
* Work with new technologies and processes to build scalable risk program

 sustainable society.

title: Commercial Finance Controller
description:
We are looking for a Commercial Finance Controller to join our Finance team.
 



 The position is based in
 **Pune, Maharashtra, India** 
 where you'll join an international company that values people, embraces diversity, and promotes employee well\-being.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**1\.** 
**Commercial Governance, Controls \& Spend Management** 



* Establish, enforce, and audit approval matrices, SOPs, and governance frameworks for all commercial spends, trade promotions, and marketing budgets.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end Gross\-to\-Net (G2N) structure, ensuring accurate accruals, timely trade claim settlements, discount reconciliations, and elimination of revenue leakages.
* Act as the finance process owner for commercial ERP modules, Sales Force Automation (SFA), and Trade Spend Management tools to ensure pricing and discount master data integrity.
* Procuremnet process and Logistics costs control : end to end process governance
* Expiry and damage policy governance



**2\. Commercial Business Partnering \& RGM Strategy** 



* Partner closely with the Sales, Trade Marketing, and Marketing leads to drive Revenue Growth Management (RGM) initiatives—including pricing strategy, price\-pack architecture, and promotional discount depth.
* Evaluate financial business cases for New Product Developments (NPDs), line extensions, new channel entry (e.g., Airlines, Institutional, Quick\-Commerce), and distributor margin structures.



**3\. Multi\-Channel Profitability \& Decision Support** 



* Deliver granular P\&L analysis across channels (General Trade, Modern Trade, E\-Commerce, Alternate Channels), customer accounts, and SKU levels.
* Develop dynamic financial dashboards, forward\-looking insights, and scenario planning models to advise senior leadership on margin optimization and growth opportunities.
* Monitor competitor pricing dynamics, input cost pressures, and trade terms to maintain market competitiveness without compromising company profitability.



**4\. Credit Control \& Distributor Financial Health** 



* Implement credit policies, set customer credit limits, and monitor accounts receivable aging to mitigate credit default risk.
* Oversee distributor financial health, claim reconciliation disputes, and credit memo issuance processes.
* Lead the annual commercial budgeting process, quarterly re\-forecasts, and monthly trade spend alignment.
* Track and present monthly commercial performance, highlighting variances against budget/forecast, risks, and proposed corrective actions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 The Commercial Finance Controller will serve as the strategic co\-pilot to the commercial team, providing total financial visibility and rigorous governance over in\-market spends.
 



 This role bridges commercial ambitions with financial discipline ensuring that trade schemes, pricing policies, channel investments, and marketing initiatives deliver optimal ROI, protect gross margins, and support sustainable, profitable growth.
 



  





**Experience Range** 




 7\-15 Yrs

description:

 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. **Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer**

 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.

 **Mechanical Engineering**

**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.

* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.

* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen.
* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

title: Executive Vice President - Account Receivable
description:
**Role description**

**About the Department:**
 The Finance Operations department in the company handles all the financial and investment decisions. It primarily focuses on maximizing shareholder value through long\-term and short\-term financial planning and the implementation of various strategies. It aims to maximize the value of a business through the planning and execution of resources.
 


  


**The Role \& Responsibilities**
 The Executive Vice President \- Order to Cash / Accounts Receivable will lead TresVista’s end\-to\-end revenue\-to\-cash agenda, with ownership across invoicing, collections, credit risk, revenue assurance, pricing insights, customer contract inputs, cash forecasting, and O2C transformation. This is a high\-impact, customer\-facing leadership role requiring strong commercial judgement, business acumen, analytical depth, and the ability to partner with stakeholders across Commercial, Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Product, and business leadership.
   

 Beyond traditional AR accounting, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, statutory audit support, DSO calculation, and transaction governance, the role will be expected to create measurable business value by anticipating risks, solving structural issues, improving cash predictability, and using technology, dashboards, automation, AI/RPA, and analytics to build a scalable O2C operating model.
 


  


**Key Role Deliverables:** 



  

  
* Commercial Finance, Revenue Insights \& Pricing Governance
  
* Partner with business and commercial teams to evaluate pricing models, cost inflators, customer discounts, sales commissions, CAC, customer lifetime value, ARR, and revenue added by channel/product
  
* Provide analytical insights on churn, customer loyalty, customer profitability, customer behavior, and revenue leakage to support strategic decision\-making
  
* Act as a core member of the pricing committee and provide inputs on price structuring, discount governance, customer viability, renewal economics, and commercial risk.
   

 Customer Contracts, Churn Mitigation \& Legal Partnership
  
* Participate in the customer contract committee and advise on payment terms, collection enforceability, contract risk, churn triggers, discounting terms, and revenue protection clauses
  
* Work closely with Legal to resolve overdue accounts, contract disputes, collection challenges, and escalations requiring formal recovery or negotiation
  
* Develop mitigation practices to reduce churn, improve customer stickiness, and strengthen contract hygiene across new and existing client relationships.
   

 Collections, International Banking \& Treasury Partnership
  
* Lead timely collections across geographies by addressing customer\-side issues, banking delays, failed payment flows, international remittance challenges, and process bottlenecks
  
* Partner with Treasury for cash forecasting, liquidity visibility, collection predictability, auto\-collection mechanisms, and banking process improvements
  
* Own DSO, CEI, ageing movement, overdue reduction, unapplied cash, and collection\-risk reporting with clear governance and escalation rhythm
  
* Digital Transformation, AI/RPA \& Control Tower
  
* Build a digital\-first O2C operating model through dashboards, RPA workflows, AI\-enabled anomaly detection, auto\-matching, cash application automation, and revenue/cash forecasting models
  
* Create exception\-based control towers for invoice accuracy, collections risk, pricing exceptions, contract\-related disputes, write\-offs, credit memos, and customer\-level exposure
  
* Drive business cases and ROI for collections platforms, EIPP/portals, cash application ML/IDP, workflow automation, and analytics\-led decision support
  
* O2C Operations, Revenue Accounting \& Controls
  
* Own end\-to\-end AR/O2C operations including billing accuracy, client invoicing, collections, cash application, credit notes, write\-off governance, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, and statutory audit support
  
* Strengthen controls around onboarding, KYC, credit limits, segregation of duties, audit trails, billing accuracy, tax/e\-invoicing readiness, and revenue handoffs
  
* Establish process discipline across customer master data, payment terms, dispute SLAs, credit governance, closing activities, and audit evidence readiness
  
* M\&A, New Service Lines \& Geographic Expansion Support
  
* Support due diligence for M\&A, acquire opportunities, new service lines, new geographies, and new end markets by evaluating customer contracts, revenue quality, receivables, collection risks, and integration readiness
  
* Standardize customer master data, collection policies, payment terms, and O2C controls where new entities, products, markets, or customer portfolios are integrated into TresVista’s operating model
  
* Stakeholder Management \& Leadership Rhythm
  
* Partner across Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Commercial, Product, business teams, and leadership to identify risks early, solve cross\-functional issues, and drive accountable outcomes
  
* Run weekly exception and ageing reviews, monthly CFO/commercial reviews, and leadership packs covering cash, risk, churn, customer health, and transformation progress
  


  


**Decision Rights** 



  

  
* Recommend and approve O2C credit, collections, customer contract, and e\-billing governance standards in partnership with relevant stakeholders
  
* Prioritize the O2C automation roadmap, exception dashboards, workflow releases, and transformation initiatives in collaboration with IT and business teams
  
* Drive escalation decisions for overdue accounts, customer exposure, policy exceptions, and credit risk mitigation actions
  
* Propose transformation investments, vendor/platform requirements, ROI cases, and operating model changes for revenue\-to\-cash scalability
  


  


**Success Measures (KPIs)** 



  

  
* Reduction in DSO, overdue balances, delinquency movement, write\-offs, and unresolved disputes
  
* Improvement in CEI, timely collections, cash forecast accuracy, and customer\-level collection predictability
  
* First\-pass invoice accuracy, billing cycle\-time reduction, reduction in pricing/contract/tax\-related rework, and faster audit evidence turnaround
  
* Improvement in ARR visibility, ARR added by channel/product, churn insights, discount governance, customer lifetime value understanding, and revenue leakage prevention
  
* Automation adoption, cash application auto\-match percentage, anomaly detection effectiveness, dashboard adoption, and measurable transformation ROI
  
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction across commercial, legal, treasury, finance, product, and leadership teams
  


  


**Prerequisites:** 



  

  
* Chartered Accountant with 8 to 14 years of experience across Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, revenue accounting, commercial finance, credit risk, collections, or transformation\-led finance operations
  
* Strong commercial and business acumen with the ability to connect invoicing, collections, pricing, contracts, customer behavior, churn, revenue forecasting, and cash forecasting
  
* Customer\-facing mindset with strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills
  
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics/D365, or equivalent finance platforms; exposure to Power BI/control towers, collection platforms, EIPP/portals, AI/RPA, cash application automation, or workflow tools will be preferred
  
* Strong understanding of international banking, collections, customer contracting, credit policy, revenue controls, SOX/ICFR, statutory audit support, and multi\-entity/multi\-jurisdiction operations
  
* High analytical orientation with advanced Excel/reporting capability and the ability to convert data into insights, actions, and business decisions
  
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate problems, design mitigation plans, solve cross\-functional issues, and operate effectively in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment
  
* Self\-driven, detail\-oriented, proactive, entrepreneurial, and willing to build scalable processes while continuing to learn and grow.
  


  


**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



  

  
* CA with 8 to 14 years of experience, preferably in a high\-growth services, consulting, SaaS, technology\-enabled, or global managed\-services environment.
  
* Proven leadership in O2C/AR, collections, revenue assurance, credit governance, customer contracts, pricing analytics, cash forecasting, and commercial finance advisory
  
* Experience working directly with customers and senior internal stakeholders to resolve collection, pricing, contract, and revenue\-related issues
  
* Strong transformation orientation with exposure to dashboards, AI/RPA, anomaly detection, cash forecasting, revenue forecasting, auto\-collection, and automation\-led finance operating models
  
* Ability to think strategically and critically while remaining hands\-on in execution, controls, governance, and stakeholder follow\-through.

 The compensation structure will be as per industry standards

Position Overview
 
  





 We are looking for a dynamic, commercially minded
 **Manager – Strategic Business Finance (FP\&A)** 
 to partner directly with the COO and executive leadership across Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Procurement.
 



 In this highly visible leadership role, you will move beyond traditional financial reporting to act as a strategic co\-pilot—translating high\-level corporate strategy into actionable financial and operational outcomes. You will drive enterprise decision\-making across commercial pricing models, capital allocation, SaaS unit economics, multi\-year financial planning, and business automation.

* **Strategic Business Partnering:** 
 Act as an embedded financial advisor to cross\-functional leaders, evaluating revenue growth levers, operational productivity, and cost\-optimization strategies.
* **FP\&A \& SaaS Performance Management:** 
 Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), rolling quarterly forecasts, and long\-range financial planning (LRFP). Monitor and analyze key SaaS metrics (
 **ARR, MRR, NRR, GRR, LTV, CAC, Churn, and Contribution Margins** 
 ).
* **Commercial Finance \& Pricing Strategy:** 
 Evaluate deal structures, enterprise discount governance, packaging models, and customer cohort profitability to maximize overall gross margin and deal velocity.
* **Financial Modeling \& Decision Support:** 
 Build dynamic business cases, ROI frameworks, and scenario planning models to evaluate strategic bets, such as AI initiatives, international expansion, strategic hiring, and tech stack investments.
* **Executive \& Investor Reporting:** 
 Prepare insight\-led executive reporting packs, Board decks, and investor presentations that articulate performance drivers and strategic recommendations.
* **BI, Analytics \& Automation:** 
 Modernize FP\&A infrastructure by leveraging Power BI, Excel/Power Query, dashboards, and AI\-driven reporting tools to accelerate report generation and deepen business visibility.
* **Governance \& Capital Allocation:** 
 Establish robust financial controls, standardize forecasting frameworks across business units, and optimize capital distribution to drive sustainable EBITDA growth.
* **Team Leadership \& Mentorship:** 
 Lead, develop, and mentor Business Finance Analysts, fostering a high\-performance culture grounded in analytical rigour and commercial strategy.



  




 Qualifications \& Requirements
 **Essential Experience \& Skills:** 

  




* **Educational Background:** 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) is
 **Mandatory** 
 . MBA (Finance) or CFA designation is highly preferred.
* **Experience Range:** 
 10–15 years of progressive experience in FP\&A, Business Finance, Commercial Finance, or Strategic Finance.
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Prior experience in SaaS, Cloud, CPaaS, B2B Enterprise Software, or Technology Subscription environments.
* **Technical Mastery:** 
 Advanced financial modeling, scenario analysis, valuation techniques, and deep proficiency in business intelligence systems (Power BI, advanced Excel analytics, ERP/CRM financial integrations).
* **Executive Presence:** 
 Proven track record of presenting to and influencing C\-Suite executives, Board me10mbers, and cross\-functional VP leaders.



  




**Desired Competencies:** 
* Strong commercial acumen and strategic problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to tell clear operational stories behind complex quantitative datasets.
* High degree of ownership, adaptability, and proactive execution.
* Passion for process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 








* Forecast Accuracy
* Budget vs Actual Variance
* Business Partner Satisfaction
* Gross Margin \& EBITDA Improvement
* Pricing \& Profitability Analysis Effectiveness
* ARR, MRR, NRR \& Customer Profitability Reporting Accuracy
* Financial Reporting Timeliness
* Automation of FP\&A Reports and Dashboards
* Capital Allocation Efficiency
* ROI of Strategic Business Initiatives
* Process Improvement \& Financial Governance Compliance
* Team Development and Stakeholder Engagement
